method: Read-only inspection of retained lint/baseline, installed pinned source and shipped native configuration; no rebuild or device execution.

suppressed_findings.scope: Console source-line diagnostic formatting; locale-dependent output remains.
Locale-sensitive host-mask comparison; no remote allowNavigation/server.url is configured, local host is fixed localhost; application ServerPolicy uses Locale.ROOT.
Remote-proxy Accept-header case conversion; current companion serves local assets and does not use remote HTML loading.
Camera temporary filename prefix; current HTML file inputs do not request capture; file uniqueness uses createTempFile.
Native Date overload can produce locale/calendar-dependent output; current HamavaDevice plugin returns strings/booleans/JSON and does not use that overload.

limits: This is not a general dependency security audit or device/locale qualification.
HTTPS and minSDK24 do not repair locale-sensitive formatting.
Remote navigation, remote server loading, camera capture or native Date serialization require reassessment if introduced.
Six unmatched old baseline entries are not six additional active suppressions and do not by themselves prove historical fixes.
